scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.db-path: node -e "require('dotenv').config();const path=require('path');const p=path.resolve(process.env.DATABASE_PATH||'./data/catalog.db');console.log('DB path (same as app):',p);const db=require('better-sqlite3')(p);const r=db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM products WHERE status=?').get('sold');console.log('Sold count in this file:',r.c);db.close();"
